request.amount_ada: none requested; proposes a 500,000,000 ada net change limit
request.deadline: Period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027
deliverables: Record DReps' agreement to a 500,000,000 ada fixed cap on total Treasury Withdrawals debited during Epochs 613-713
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period
Clarify that prior withdrawals already debited during the period count toward the limit
request.what: Info action to agree a new Net Change Limit for Cardano Treasury withdrawals for Epochs 613-713

claims.claim: The proposal sets a new Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.
The proposed limit applies from the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 through the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027.
The Net Change Limit caps only amounts removed from the Treasury by enacted Treasury Withdrawals recorded on the Cardano ledger, and does not count Treasury inflows.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period count toward the proposed 500,000,000 ada limit and are not reset, reversed, reopened, or reauthorized by this action.
The document says this action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposer states that the existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713 has become practically constrained as its window runs into mid-2027.
The proposer claims that increasing the limit to 500,000,000 ada preserves DReps' ability to consider credible Treasury Withdrawals on their merits while retaining a fixed fiscal guardrail.
The document states that Yes votes exceeding 50% of active voting stake are the TREASURY-01a threshold for agreeing a Net Change Limit.
The proposer states that the action is drafted to comply with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and provides an IPFS reference to the Constitution.
The proposer states that nothing in the Constitution limits DReps to a single Net Change Limit or prevents a newly agreed Net Change Limit from applying to the period.

summary: The document proposes an informational governance signal establishing a 500,000,000 ada Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713, replacing a prior 350,000,000 ada limit for the same period, with ledger-debited withdrawals counting cumulatively and no direct authorization of spending.
